text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Long after training had been scheduled to start,
I bumped into Fuji Kiseki dashing all over the place—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Sorry for startling you!
I was in a bit of a rush...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: One of the dorm students came down with a fever...! I'm looking after them right now!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I have to deliver the fever reducer quickly...!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, it can't be helped, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It's training day!
Ugh... I totally messed up...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My mind was completely occupied with nursing her—
I'm so sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I really need to keep my cool more.
I'll be careful from now on...!"
